title: Continuously hardening ChatGPT Atlas against prompt injection
summary: OpenAI is strengthening ChatGPT Atlas against prompt injection attacks using automated red teaming trained with reinforcement learning. This proactive discover-and-patch loop helps identify novel exploits early and harden the browser agent’s defenses as AI becomes more agentic.
body: OpenAI is strengthening ChatGPT Atlas against prompt injection attacks using automated red teaming trained with reinforcement learning. This proactive discover-and-patch loop helps identify novel exploits early and harden the browser agent’s defenses as AI becomes more agentic.
summaryZh: OpenAI正在通过自动化红队测试（Automated Red Teaming）强化ChatGPT Atlas的安全性，重点防御提示词注入攻击。该机制通过强化学习构建“发现-修复”循环，旨在随着AI代理化程度的加深，主动识别并修补潜在漏洞，从而提升系统的整体防御韧性。
